== Slip and reconstruction are one version ==
A printable '''slip''' (picture area blank or a lower-band overlay) and a later '''full reconstruction''' of the '''same''' errata sit on one article: full card in the infobox, slip under it ([[SWCCG Wiki:Style guide]] / #583). They are not two errata versions.

Worked dest: [[Admiral Motti (Errata)]] — D-E1 reconstruction on top, 2017 E slip below. [[Admiral Motti (PC Errata)]], [[Admiral Motti (PC Errata 2)]], and [[Admiral Motti (PC Errata 3)]] redirect there.
